svg.title: Tokens used summary and local lab
svg.desc: OpenCode usage and local lab (mobile). Mode production. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-05. Hero size 360×708.

g.title: Tokens used summary: all providers, includes cache
g.desc: Full calendar year 2026, Monday-first UTC. Totals cover January 1 up to 2026-10-05 (exclusive, delayed). Future and not-yet-reported cells have no usage value. Qualified daily totals are in the measurement JSON and cell titles; missing dates are not zero. All recorded OpenCode providers, no added gateway.
g.text: Marked: unknown. Faint: not yet reported.

g.title: Local AI lab card
g.desc: Local inference lab: Qwen3-Coder-Next. Memory class Q5_K_M / 128 GB memory class. Status 'Research target / not installed'. The lab is rendered as a reserved slot in the public hero; the renderer never claims a measurement that the snapshot has not produced.

g.title: Cluster inventory card
g.desc: Configured cluster facts (nodes, VMs, LXCs and local models), not uptime or presence. Missing values remain unavailable.
